answer: Hold graded payment at the wharf: nothing leaves the dock until a panel of strangers clears it, and nobody may audit an identity it recruited. Replaying a submission already on the ledger claws the full amount back, so every copy must write something new. An anchor identity that pads its own recruits is caught at panel assembly, before payout. Price it: 1,000 fakes mean 1,000 funded escrows and 1,000 fresh texts before the first coin, plus an umber mark on anyone caught replaying.
